data.why: The app fetches TESS TargetPixelFiles/TESSCut, Gaia/TIC, ZTF, ASAS-SN SkyPatrol and VSX catalog data live from MAST and related archives by TIC ID entered in the UI; there is no local example file to seed.

goals: Enter a TIC ID and load its TESS target pixel file (or TESSCut cutout) to inspect pixel-level photometry
Overlay the pixel view with TIC/Gaia DR3 catalog sources to identify nearby contaminating stars
Select apertures/pixels interactively and view the resulting light curve
Cross-match the target against ZTF Archive and ASAS-SN SkyPatrol v2 light curves to corroborate a variable signal
Check VSX for existing variable-star classifications of the target or nearby sources
Diagnose whether a detected signal originates from the target star or a nearby blended source

review.summary: The tree states the tool's purpose correctly (deciding which star a variable signal comes from), and the pixel-level light-curve, time-scrubbing and per-pixel stages are well staged, well worded and mostly well evidenced. It needs fixes before filing: the Gaia/TIC contamination check the README centres on, plus VSX and SkyPatrol, are missing from the tree because those queries failed; the external-survey stage was not confirmed by the replay; and a few citations (036, 030, the fold of an unrelated ZTF ID) don't show what their nodes claim.
